name: Something Went Wrong
description: catches Drupal exceptions and sends them to Slack or email.
project_description:
Drupal embraces the principle of throwing exceptions when something goes wrong in the code. When an error occurs, Drupal will come to a complete stop.

 While this behavior is helpful for developers during the development phase, as it clearly highlights issues, it's far less ideal for site visitors when the site is live. This module effectively addresses both concerns.

 Avoid unpleasant calls and situations where a client reports an error in your product.

 This module captures site errors and notifies developers via Slack or email whenever an issue arises.
